_doc: Weakness class x architecture applicability (FR-015, FR-016).
This file may ONLY encode impossibility that is true BY CONSTRUCTION. A wrong
suppression is a false negative, which the review that motivated this feature
showed to be the more damaging error direction, so stylistic judgements and
'unlikely in practice' claims do not belong here.
Semantics: a weakness class is ruled out for a finding only when NONE of the
architecture shapes reachable from its location appears in requires_any. An
'undetermined' shape, or undetermined reachability, never rules anything out
(FR-013a, FR-015c). Reachability spans workspace members, so a browser-only
client whose value reaches a sibling server retains server-side classes
Adding an entry is a data change and must require no pipeline change (FR-013c).

rules.name: Server-Side Request Forgery
rules.rationale: Request forgery is dangerous because a server issues the attacker-influenced request from inside a trust boundary: internal services, cloud metadata, and firewall bypass become reachable. A browser-only client issues the request from the victim's own machine, with no internal network reachable and no ambient credentials attached, so none of that impact exists. The underlying code fact - an untrusted value interpolated into a URL without encoding or validation - remains real and is defensible as improper input validation (CWE-20) or improper encoding (CWE-116).
rules.evidence: Independent review of scan 20260830T113443Z-00250b: 'There is no server in this repo - it is a static SPA. Calling it SSRF will misroute this to the wrong SLA and the wrong reviewer.'

rules.name: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference
rules.rationale: XXE requires an XML parser that resolves external entities. Browser XML parsing does not resolve external entities, so the class is not achievable in a browser-only context; the parsing of untrusted input remains a validation concern.
